.PHONY: all clean

Require Import Program.Tactics.
=== Base.v ===
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Export Morphisms.

Section Iter.

Variables (X: Type) (f: X -> X).

Fixpoint it n x : X :=
    match n with
    | 0 => x
    | S n'=> f (it n' x)
    end.

End Iter.

Notation "{ x & P }" := (sigT (fun x => P)) : type_scope.

Inductive inhab (X: Type) :Prop :=
  | inhabited: X -> inhab X.
=== fintype.v ===
Require Export axioms.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Unset Strict Implicit.

Definition ap {X Y} (f : X -> Y) {x y : X} (p : x = y) : f x = f y :=
  match p with eq_refl => eq_refl end.

Definition apc {X Y} {f g : X -> Y} {x y : X} (p : f = g) (q : x = y) : f x = g y :=
  match q with eq_refl => match p with eq_refl => eq_refl end end.

Fixpoint fin (n : nat) : Type :=
  match n with
  | 0 => False
  | S m => option (fin m)
  end.

Definition funcomp {X Y Z} (g : Y -> Z) (f : X -> Y)  :=
  fun x => g (f x).

Class Subst1 (X : nat -> Type) (Y : nat -> Type) :=
  subst1 : forall {m n}, (fin m -> X n) -> Y m -> Y n.

Class Ren1 (X : nat -> Type) :=
  ren1 : forall {m n}, (fin m -> fin n) -> X m -> X n.

Class Subst2 (X1 X2 : nat -> Type) (Y : nat -> nat -> Type) :=
  subst2 : forall {m1 m2 n1 n2}, (fin m1 -> X1 n1) -> (fin m2 -> X2 n2) -> Y m1 m2 -> Y n1 n2.

Class Ren2 (X : nat -> Type) :=
  ren2 : forall {m n}, (fin m -> fin n) -> X m -> X n.

Notation "s [ sigma ]" := (@subst1 _ _ _ _ _ sigma s) (at level 7, left associativity, format "s '/' [ sigma ]") : subst_scope.

Notation "s [ sigma ; tau ]" := (subst1  sigma tau s) (at level 7, left associativity, format "s '/' [ sigma ; '/'  tau ]") : subst_scope.

Notation "s ⟨ sigma ⟩" := (@ren1 _ _ _ _ sigma s) (at level 7, left associativity, format "s '/' ⟨ sigma ⟩") : subst_scope.

Notation "[ sigma ]" := (@subst1 _ _ _ _ _ sigma) (at level 1, left associativity) : fscope.

Notation "⟨ xi ⟩" := (@ren1 _ _ _ _ xi) (at level 1, left associativity, format "⟨ xi ⟩") : fscope.

Arguments funcomp {X Y Z} (g)%fscope (f)%fscope.

Notation "f >> g" := (funcomp g f)   (at level 50).

Open Scope subst_scope.

Definition scons {X : Type} {n : nat} (x : X) (f : fin n -> X) (m : fin (S n)) : X :=
  match m with
  | None => x
  | Some i => f i
  end.

Notation "x .: f" := (@scons _ _ x f) (at level 55) : subst_scope.

Definition ren (m n : nat) : Type := fin m -> fin n.

Definition bound {n : nat} : fin (S n) := None.

Definition null {T} (i : fin 0) : T := match i with end.

Definition shift {n : nat} : ren n (S n) :=
  Some.

Definition up_ren m n (xi : ren m n) : ren (S m) (S n) :=
  bound .: xi >> shift.

Definition var_zero {n : nat} : fin (S n) := None.

Definition idren {k: nat} : ren k k :=
  fun x => x.

Definition comp := @funcomp.

Definition id {X} (x : X) := x.

Class Var (X : nat -> Type) :=
  ids : forall {m}, fin m -> X m.

Module CommaNotation.

Notation "s , sigma" := (scons s sigma) (at level 60, format "s ,  sigma", right associativity) : subst_scope.

End CommaNotation.

Notation "s '..'" := (scons s ids) (at level 1, format "s ..") : subst_scope.

Notation "↑" := (shift) : subst_scope.

=== Syntax.v ===
Require Export fintype.

Inductive valtype  : Type :=
  | zero : valtype
  | one : valtype
  | U : comptype  -> valtype
  | Sigma : valtype  -> valtype  -> valtype
  | cross : valtype  -> valtype  -> valtype
 with comptype  : Type :=
  | cone : comptype
  | F : valtype  -> comptype
  | Pi : comptype  -> comptype  -> comptype
  | arrow : valtype  -> comptype  -> comptype .

Inductive value (nvalue : nat) : Type :=
  | var_value : fin (nvalue) -> value (nvalue)
  | u : value (nvalue)
  | pair : value (nvalue) -> value (nvalue) -> value (nvalue)
  | inj : bool  -> value (nvalue) -> value (nvalue)
  | thunk : comp (nvalue) -> value (nvalue)
 with comp (nvalue : nat) : Type :=
  | cu : comp (nvalue)
  | force : value (nvalue) -> comp (nvalue)
  | lambda : comp (S nvalue) -> comp (nvalue)
  | app : comp (nvalue) -> value (nvalue) -> comp (nvalue)
  | tuple : comp (nvalue) -> comp (nvalue) -> comp (nvalue)
  | ret : value (nvalue) -> comp (nvalue)
  | letin : comp (nvalue) -> comp (S nvalue) -> comp (nvalue)
  | proj : bool  -> comp (nvalue) -> comp (nvalue)
  | caseZ : value (nvalue) -> comp (nvalue)
  | caseS : value (nvalue) -> comp (S nvalue) -> comp (S nvalue) -> comp (nvalue)
  | caseP : value (nvalue) -> comp (S (S nvalue)) -> comp (nvalue).

Definition upRen_value_value { m : nat } { n : nat } (xi : fin (m) -> fin (n)) : _ :=
  up_ren xi.

Fixpoint ren_value { mvalue : nat } { nvalue : nat } (xivalue : fin (mvalue) -> fin (nvalue)) (s : value (mvalue)) : _ :=
    match s with
    | var_value (_) s => (var_value (nvalue)) (xivalue s)
    | u (_)  => u (nvalue)
    | pair (_) s0 s1 => pair (nvalue) (ren_value xivalue s0) (ren_value xivalue s1)
    | inj (_) s0 s1 => inj (nvalue) s0 (ren_value xivalue s1)
    | thunk (_) s0 => thunk (nvalue) (ren_comp xivalue s0)
    end
 with ren_comp { mvalue : nat } { nvalue : nat } (xivalue : fin (mvalue) -> fin (nvalue)) (s : comp (mvalue)) : _ :=
    match s with
    | cu (_)  => cu (nvalue)
    | force (_) s0 => force (nvalue) (ren_value xivalue s0)
    | lambda (_) s0 => lambda (nvalue) (ren_comp (upRen_value_value xivalue) s0)
    | app (_) s0 s1 => app (nvalue) (ren_comp xivalue s0) (ren_value xivalue s1)
    | tuple (_) s0 s1 => tuple (nvalue) (ren_comp xivalue s0) (ren_comp xivalue s1)
    | ret (_) s0 => ret (nvalue) (ren_value xivalue s0)
    | letin (_) s0 s1 => letin (nvalue) (ren_comp xivalue s0) (ren_comp (upRen_value_value xivalue) s1)
    | proj (_) s0 s1 => proj (nvalue) s0 (ren_comp xivalue s1)
    | caseZ (_) s0 => caseZ (nvalue) (ren_value xivalue s0)
    | caseS (_) s0 s1 s2 => caseS (nvalue) (ren_value xivalue s0) (ren_comp (upRen_value_value xivalue) s1) (ren_comp (upRen_value_value xivalue) s2)
    | caseP (_) s0 s1 => caseP (nvalue) (ren_value xivalue s0) (ren_comp (upRen_value_value (upRen_value_value xivalue)) s1)
    end.

Definition up_value_value { m : nat } { nvalue : nat } (sigma : fin (m) -> value (nvalue)) : _ :=
  scons ((var_value (S nvalue)) var_zero) (funcomp (ren_value shift) sigma).

Fixpoint subst_value { mvalue : nat } { nvalue : nat } (sigmavalue : fin (mvalue) -> value (nvalue)) (s : value (mvalue)) : _ :=
    match s with
    | var_value (_) s => sigmavalue s
    | u (_)  => u (nvalue)
    | pair (_) s0 s1 => pair (nvalue) (subst_value sigmavalue s0) (subst_value sigmavalue s1)
    | inj (_) s0 s1 => inj (nvalue) s0 (subst_value sigmavalue s1)
    | thunk (_) s0 => thunk (nvalue) (subst_comp sigmavalue s0)
    end
 with subst_comp { mvalue : nat } { nvalue : nat } (sigmavalue : fin (mvalue) -> value (nvalue)) (s : comp (mvalue)) : _ :=
    match s with
    | cu (_)  => cu (nvalue)
    | force (_) s0 => force (nvalue) (subst_value sigmavalue s0)
    | lambda (_) s0 => lambda (nvalue) (subst_comp (up_value_value sigmavalue) s0)
    | app (_) s0 s1 => app (nvalue) (subst_comp sigmavalue s0) (subst_value sigmavalue s1)
    | tuple (_) s0 s1 => tuple (nvalue) (subst_comp sigmavalue s0) (subst_comp sigmavalue s1)
    | ret (_) s0 => ret (nvalue) (subst_value sigmavalue s0)
    | letin (_) s0 s1 => letin (nvalue) (subst_comp sigmavalue s0) (subst_comp (up_value_value sigmavalue) s1)
    | proj (_) s0 s1 => proj (nvalue) s0 (subst_comp sigmavalue s1)
    | caseZ (_) s0 => caseZ (nvalue) (subst_value sigmavalue s0)
    | caseS (_) s0 s1 s2 => caseS (nvalue) (subst_value sigmavalue s0) (subst_comp (up_value_value sigmavalue) s1) (subst_comp (up_value_value sigmavalue) s2)
    | caseP (_) s0 s1 => caseP (nvalue) (subst_value sigmavalue s0) (subst_comp (up_value_value (up_value_value sigmavalue)) s1)
    end.

Arguments var_value {nvalue}.

Arguments u {nvalue}.

Arguments pair {nvalue}.

Arguments inj {nvalue}.

Arguments thunk {nvalue}.

Arguments cu {nvalue}.

Arguments force {nvalue}.

Arguments lambda {nvalue}.

Arguments app {nvalue}.

Arguments tuple {nvalue}.

Arguments ret {nvalue}.

Arguments letin {nvalue}.

Arguments proj {nvalue}.

Arguments caseZ {nvalue}.

Arguments caseS {nvalue}.

Arguments caseP {nvalue}.

Instance Subst_value : Subst1 value value := @subst_value .

Instance Subst_comp : Subst1 value comp := @subst_comp .

Instance Ren_value : Ren1 value := @ren_value .

Instance Ren_comp : Ren1 comp := @ren_comp .

Instance VarInstance_value : Var value := @var_value .

Notation "x '__value'" := (@ids value VarInstance_value (_) x) (at level 30, format "x __value") : subst_scope.

Notation "⇑__value" := (@up_value_value (_)) (only printing) : subst_scope.
=== Terms.v ===
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Logic List Classes.Morphisms.

Import List Notations.

Require Export Syntax Base AbstractReductionSystems.

Scheme value_ind_2 := Induction for value Sort Prop
  with comp_ind_2  := Induction for comp Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme mutind_val_comp from value_ind_2, comp_ind_2.

Inductive valtype : Type :=
| zero: valtype
| one: valtype
| U: comptype -> valtype
| Sigma: valtype -> valtype -> valtype
| cross: valtype -> valtype -> valtype


with comptype : Type :=
| cone: comptype
| F: valtype -> comptype
| Pi: comptype -> comptype -> comptype
| arrow: valtype -> comptype -> comptype.

Scheme valtype_ind_2 := Induction for valtype Sort Prop
  with comptype_ind_2  := Induction for comptype Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme mutind_valtype_comptype from valtype_ind_2, comptype_ind_2.

Inductive groundtype : Type :=
| gone : groundtype
| gsum : groundtype -> groundtype -> groundtype
| gcross : groundtype -> groundtype -> groundtype.

Fixpoint to_valtype (G: groundtype) :=
  match G with
  | gone => one
  | gsum G1 G2 => Sigma (to_valtype  G1) (to_valtype  G2)
  | gcross G1 G2 => cross (to_valtype  G1) (to_valtype  G2)
  end.

Coercion to_valtype: groundtype >-> valtype.

Fixpoint nat_to_fin {m: nat} (n: nat)  : fin (S (it S n m)) :=
  match n with
  | O => var_zero

| typeVar i : Gamma ⊩ var_value i : Gamma i
| typeUnit: Gamma ⊩ u : one
| typePair v1 v2 A1 A2:
    Gamma ⊩ v1 : A1 -> Gamma ⊩ v2 : A2 -> Gamma ⊩ pair v1 v2 : cross A1 A2
| typeSum A1 A2 (b: bool) v:
    Gamma ⊩ v : (if b then A1 else A2) -> Gamma ⊩ inj b v : Sigma A1 A2

where "Gamma ⊩ v : A" := (value_typing Gamma v A)


with computation_typing {m: nat} (Gamma: ctx m) : comp m -> comptype -> Type :=
| typeCone: Gamma ⊢ cu : cone
| typeLambda (c: comp (S m)) A B:
    A .: Gamma ⊢ c : B -> (Gamma ⊢ lambda c : A → B)
| typeLetin c1 c2 A B:
    Gamma ⊢ c1 : F A -> A .: Gamma ⊢ c2 : B -> Gamma ⊢ $ <- c1; c2 : B
| typeRet v A:
    Gamma ⊩ v : A -> Gamma ⊢ ret v : F A
| typeApp c v A B:
    Gamma ⊢ c : A → B -> Gamma ⊩ v : A -> Gamma ⊢ c v : B
| typeTuple c1 c2 B1 B2:
    Gamma ⊢ c1 : B1  -> Gamma ⊢ c2 : B2 -> Gamma ⊢ tuple c1 c2 : Pi B1 B2
| typeProj b c B1 B2:
    Gamma ⊢ c : Pi B1 B2 -> Gamma ⊢ proj b c : (if b then B1 else B2)
| typeForce v A:
    Gamma ⊩ v : U A -> Gamma ⊢ v! : A
| typeCaseZ v A: Gamma ⊩ v : zero -> Gamma ⊢ caseZ v : A
| typeCaseS v c1 c2 A1 A2 C:
    Gamma ⊩ v : Sigma A1 A2 ->
    A1, Gamma ⊢ c1 : C ->
    A2, Gamma ⊢ c2 : C ->
    Gamma ⊢ caseS v c1 c2 : C
| typeCaseP v c A B C:
    Gamma ⊩ v : A * B ->
    B, A, Gamma  ⊢ c : C ->

Variables (X: Type) (R: X -> X -> Prop).

Implicit Types x y z : X.

Definition functional := forall x y z, R x y -> R x z -> y = z.

Inductive star : X -> X -> Prop :=
  | starRefl x     : star x x
  | starStep x x' y : R x x' -> star x' y -> star x y.

Inductive plus : X -> X -> Prop :=
  | plusSingle x y: R x y -> plus x y
  | plusStep x x' y: R x x' -> plus x' y -> plus x y.

Inductive counted : nat -> X -> X -> Prop :=
  | countedRefl x: counted 0 x x
  | countedStep x x' y n: R x x' -> counted n x' y -> counted (S n) x y.

Inductive sym: X -> X -> Prop :=
  | symId x y: R x y -> sym x y
  | symInv x y: R y x -> sym x y.

End ClosureRelations.

Variable X: Type.

End Properties.

Variables (X A: Type).

  | SNC x : (forall y, R x y -> SN R y) -> SN R x.

Definition diamond R := forall x y z, R x y -> R x z -> joinable R y z.

| stepLetin (c1 c1': comp n) c2: c1 > c1' -> $ <- c1; c2 > $ <- c1'; c2
where "A > B" := (step A B).

Notation "A >* B" := (star step A B) (at level 60).

Notation "A >+ B" := (plus step A B) (at level 60).

Inductive ectx {n: nat}: Type :=
| ectxHole : ectx
| ectxApp : ectx -> value n -> ectx
| ectxProj : bool -> ectx -> ectx
| ectxLetin : ectx -> comp (S n) -> ectx.

Fixpoint fill {n: nat} (K: ectx) (c: comp n) :=
  match K with
  | ectxHole => c
  | ectxApp K v => (fill K c) v
  | ectxProj b K => proj b (fill K c)
  | ectxLetin K c' => letin (fill K c) c'
  end.

Inductive cstep {n: nat}: comp n -> comp n -> Prop :=
| contextStep C c c' (c'' c''': comp n):
    c ≽ c' -> fill C c = c'' -> fill C c' = c''' -> c'' ⇝ c'''
where "A '⇝' B" := (cstep A B).

Reserved Notation "A ▷ B" (at level 80).

Inductive bigstep {n: nat}: comp n -> comp n -> Prop :=
| bigstepCu: @cu n ▷ cu
| bigstepReturn (v: value n) : ret v ▷ ret v
| bigstepLambda (c: comp (S n)) : lambda c ▷ lambda c
| bigstepTuple (c1 c2: comp n): tuple c1 c2 ▷ tuple c1 c2
| bigstepForce (c c': comp n): c ▷ c' -> <{c}>! ▷ c'
| bigstepApp (c c'': comp n) c' v: c ▷ lambda c' -> c'[v..] ▷ c'' -> c v ▷ c''
| bigstepProj c c' (c1 c2: comp n) (b: bool):

| bigstepLetin c1 (v: value n) c2 c: c1 ▷ ret v -> c2[v..] ▷ c -> $ <- c1; c2 ▷ c

where "A ▷ B" := (bigstep A B).

Inductive nf {n: nat}: comp n -> Prop :=
| nfCu: nf cu
| nfLam c: nf (lambda c)
| nfTup c1 c2: nf (tuple c1 c2)
| nfRet v: nf (ret v).

Definition eval {n: nat} (c c': comp n) := c >* c' /\ nf c'.

Require Import Logic List Classes.Morphisms.

Definition ctx (n: nat) := fin n -> valtype.

Inductive value_typing {m: nat} (Gamma: ctx m) : value m -> valtype -> Type :=
| typeVar i : Gamma ⊩ var_value i : Gamma i
| typeUnit: Gamma ⊩ u : one
| typePair v1 v2 A1 A2:
    Gamma ⊩ v1 : A1 -> Gamma ⊩ v2 : A2 -> Gamma ⊩ pair v1 v2 : cross A1 A2
| typeSum A1 A2 (b: bool) v:
    Gamma ⊩ v : (if b then A1 else A2) -> Gamma ⊩ inj b v : Sigma A1 A2
| typeThunk c A:
    Gamma ⊢ c : A -> Gamma ⊩ thunk c : U A
where "Gamma ⊩ v : A" := (value_typing Gamma v A)


with computation_typing {m: nat} (Gamma: ctx m) : comp m -> comptype -> Type :=
| typeCone: Gamma ⊢ cu : cone
| typeLambda (c: comp (S m)) A B:
    A .: Gamma ⊢ c : B -> (Gamma ⊢ lambda c : A → B)
| typeLetin c1 c2 A B:
    Gamma ⊢ c1 : F A -> A .: Gamma ⊢ c2 : B -> Gamma ⊢ $ <- c1; c2 : B
| typeRet v A:
    Gamma ⊩ v : A -> Gamma ⊢ ret v : F A
| typeApp c v A B:
    Gamma ⊢ c : A → B -> Gamma ⊩ v : A -> Gamma ⊢ c v : B
| typeTuple c1 c2 B1 B2:
    Gamma ⊢ c1 : B1  -> Gamma ⊢ c2 : B2 -> Gamma ⊢ tuple c1 c2 : Pi B1 B2
| typeProj b c B1 B2:
    Gamma ⊢ c : Pi B1 B2 -> Gamma ⊢ proj b c : (if b then B1 else B2)
| typeForce v A:
    Gamma ⊩ v : U A -> Gamma ⊢ v! : A
| typeCaseZ v A: Gamma ⊩ v : zero -> Gamma ⊢ caseZ v : A
| typeCaseS v c1 c2 A1 A2 C:
    Gamma ⊩ v : Sigma A1 A2 ->
    A1, Gamma ⊢ c1 : C ->
    A2, Gamma ⊢ c2 : C ->
    Gamma ⊢ caseS v c1 c2 : C
| typeCaseP v c A B C:
    Gamma ⊩ v : A * B ->
    B, A, Gamma  ⊢ c : C ->
    Gamma ⊢ caseP v c : C
where "Gamma ⊢ c : A" := (@computation_typing _ Gamma c A).

Scheme value_typing_ind_2 := Minimality for value_typing Sort Prop
  with computation_typing_ind_2  := Minimality for computation_typing Sort Prop.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Morphisms FinFun Base.

Notation "R <<= S" := (forall x y, R x y -> S x y) (at level 70).

Notation "R === S" := (R <<= S /\ S <<= R) (at level 70).

Section ClosureRelations.

Variables (X: Type) (R: X -> X -> Prop).

Implicit Types x y z : X.

Definition functional := forall x y z, R x y -> R x z -> y = z.

Inductive star : X -> X -> Prop :=
  | starRefl x     : star x x
  | starStep x x' y : R x x' -> star x' y -> star x y.

Inductive plus : X -> X -> Prop :=
  | plusSingle x y: R x y -> plus x y
  | plusStep x x' y: R x x' -> plus x' y -> plus x y.

Inductive counted : nat -> X -> X -> Prop :=
  | countedRefl x: counted 0 x x
  | countedStep x x' y n: R x x' -> counted n x' y -> counted (S n) x y.

Inductive sym: X -> X -> Prop :=
  | symId x y: R x y -> sym x y
  | symInv x y: R y x -> sym x y.

End ClosureRelations.

Definition equiv X (R: X -> X -> Prop) := star (sym R).

Section Properties.

Variable X: Type.

Implicit Types (x y z : X) (R S : X -> X -> Prop).

End Properties.

Section StrongNormalisation.

Variables (X A: Type).

Variables (R: X -> X -> Prop) (S: A -> A -> Prop).

Definition Normal x := forall y, ~ R x y.

Definition evaluates s t := star R s t /\ Normal t.

Inductive SN {X} (R: X -> X -> Prop) : X -> Prop :=
  | SNC x : (forall y, R x y -> SN R y) -> SN R x.

Definition morphism  (f: X -> A) := forall x y, R x  y -> S (f x) (f y).

End StrongNormalisation.

Section Confluence.

Variable X: Type.

Implicit Types (x y z : X) (R S : X -> X -> Prop).

Definition joinable R x y := exists2 z, R x z & R y z.

Definition diamond R := forall x y z, R x y -> R x z -> joinable R y z.

Definition confluent R := diamond (star R).

Definition semi_confluent R :=
    forall x y z, R x y -> star R x z -> joinable (star R) y z.

End Confluence.

Inductive starL {X: Type} (R: X -> X -> Prop) (x : X):  X -> Prop :=
| starReflL : starL R x x
| starStepL  y y':  starL R x y -> R y y' -> starL R x y'.

| sstepLambda (c c': comp (S n)): c ↪ c' -> lambda c ↪ lambda c'
| sstepAppL (c c': comp n) v: c ↪ c' -> c v ↪ c' v

| sstepTupleL (c1 c1': comp n) c2: c1 ↪ c1' -> tuple c1 c2 ↪ tuple c1' c2
| sstepTupleR c1 (c2 c2': comp n): c2 ↪ c2' -> tuple c1 c2 ↪ tuple c1 c2'

| sstepCaseSV (v v': value n) c1 c2: v ↪ᵥ v' -> caseS v c1 c2 ↪ caseS v' c1 c2
| sstepCaseSL (v: value n) c1 c1' c2: c1 ↪ c1' -> caseS v c1 c2 ↪ caseS v c1' c2
| sstepCaseSR (v: value n) c1 c2 c2': c2 ↪ c2' -> caseS v c1 c2 ↪ caseS v c1 c2'
| sstepCasePV (v v': value n) c: v ↪ᵥ v' -> caseP v c ↪ caseP v' c
| sstepCasePC (v: value n) c c': c ↪ c' -> caseP v c ↪ caseP v c'
| sstepPrimitive (c c': comp n) : c ≽ c' -> c ↪ c'

| sstepValueThunk (c c': comp n) : c ↪ c' -> <{ c }> ↪ᵥ <{ c' }>

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Logic List Classes.Morphisms.

Import List Notations.

Require Export SyntacticTyping.

Inductive vctx (t: bool) (m: nat): nat -> Type :=
  | vctxHole : (if t then True else False) -> vctx t m m
  | vctxPairL n: vctx t m n -> value m -> vctx t m n
  | vctxPairR n : value m -> vctx t m n -> vctx t m n
  | vctxInj n : bool -> vctx t m n -> vctx t m n
  | vctxThunk n : cctx t m n -> vctx t m n


with cctx (t: bool) (m: nat) : nat -> Type :=
  | cctxHole: (if t then False else True) -> cctx t m m
  | cctxForce n : vctx t m n -> cctx t m n
  | cctxLambda n: cctx t (S m) n -> cctx t m n
  | cctxAppL n:  cctx t m n -> value m -> cctx t m n
  | cctxAppR n:  comp m -> vctx t m n -> cctx t m n
  | cctxTupleL n: cctx t m n -> comp m -> cctx t m n
  | cctxTupleR n: comp m -> cctx t m n -> cctx t m n
  | cctxRet n: vctx t m n -> cctx t m n
  | cctxLetinL n: cctx t m n -> comp (S m) -> cctx t m n
  | cctxLetinR n: comp m -> cctx t (S m) n -> cctx t m n
  | cctxProj n: bool -> cctx t m n -> cctx t m n
  | cctxCaseZ n: vctx t m n -> cctx t m n
  | cctxCaseSV n: vctx t m n -> comp (S m) -> comp (S m) -> cctx t m n
  | cctxCaseSL n: value m -> cctx t (S m) n -> comp (S m) -> cctx t m n
  | cctxCaseSR n: value m -> comp (S m) -> cctx t (S m) n -> cctx t m n
  | cctxCasePV n: vctx t m n -> comp (S (S m)) -> cctx t m n
  | cctxCasePC n: value m -> cctx t (S (S m)) n -> cctx t m n.

Scheme vctx_ind_2 := Induction for vctx Sort Prop
  with cctx_ind_2  := Induction for cctx Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme mutind_vctx_cctx from vctx_ind_2, cctx_ind_2.

Notation "'•__v'" := (vctxHole true _ I).

Notation "'•__c'" := (cctxHole false _ I).

Fixpoint fillv {m n: nat} {t: bool} (C: vctx t m n) : (if t then value n else comp n) -> value m :=
  match C in vctx _ _ n return (if t then value n else comp n) -> value m with
  | vctxHole _ _ H =>
    (match t return (if t then True else False) -> (if t then value m else comp m) -> value m with
    |  true => fun _ v' => v'
    | false => fun f _ => match f with end
    end) H
  | vctxPairL C v => fun v' => pair (fillv C v') v
  | vctxPairR v C => fun v' => pair v (fillv C v')
  | vctxInj b C => fun v' => inj b (fillv C v')
  | vctxThunk C => fun v' => <{ fillc C v' }>
  end
with fillc {m n: nat} {t: bool} (C: cctx t m n) : (if t then value n else comp n) -> comp m :=
  match C in cctx _ _ n return (if t then value n else comp n) -> comp m with
  | cctxHole _ _ H =>
    (match t return (if t then False else True) -> (if t then value m else comp m) -> comp m with
     | false => fun _ v' => v'
     | true => fun f _ => match f with end
     end) H
  | cctxForce C => fun v' => (fillv C v') !
  | cctxLambda C => fun v' => lambda (fillc C v')
  | cctxAppL C v => fun v' => (fillc C v') v
  | cctxAppR c C => fun v' => c (fillv C v')
  | cctxTupleL C c => fun v' => tuple (fillc C v') c
  | cctxTupleR c C => fun v' => tuple c (fillc C v')
  | cctxRet C => fun v' => ret (fillv C v')
  | cctxLetinL C c => fun v' => letin (fillc C v') c
  | cctxLetinR c C => fun v' => letin c (fillc C v')
  | cctxProj b C => fun v' => proj b (fillc C v')
  | cctxCaseZ C => fun v' => caseZ (fillv C v')
  | cctxCaseSV C c1 c2 => fun v' => caseS (fillv C v') c1 c2
  | cctxCaseSL v C c2 => fun v' => caseS v (fillc C v') c2
  | cctxCaseSR v c1 C => fun v' => caseS v c1 (fillc C v')
  | cctxCasePV C c => fun v' => caseP (fillv C v') c
  | cctxCasePC v C => fun v' => caseP v (fillc C v')
  end.

Reserved Notation "Gamma [[ Delta ]] ⊢ C : B ; T" (at level 53, C at level 99).

Reserved Notation "Gamma [[ Delta ]] ⊩ C : A ; T" (at level 53,  C at level 99).

Definition valtypeif (t: bool) (A: valtype):
  (if t then True else False) -> if t then valtype else comptype :=
  match t with
  | true => fun _ => A
  | false => fun f => match f with end
  end.

Definition comptypeif (t: bool) (B: comptype):
  (if t then False else True) -> if t then valtype else comptype :=
  match t with
  | false => fun _ => B
  | true => fun f => match f with end
  end.

Inductive vctxTyping {m: nat} {t: bool} (Gamma: ctx m) :
  forall n, ctx n -> vctx t m n -> valtype -> (if t then valtype else comptype) -> Type :=
| vctxTypingHole A H:
    Gamma [[ Gamma ]] ⊩ vctxHole t m H : A; valtypeif t A H
| vctxTypingPairL n (Delta: ctx n) (C: vctx t m n) A A1 A2 v:
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊩ C : A1; A ->
    Gamma ⊩ v : A2  ->
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊩ vctxPairL C v : A1 * A2; A
| vctxTypingPairR n (Delta: ctx n) (C: vctx t m n) A A1 A2 v:
    Gamma ⊩ v : A1  ->
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊩ C : A2; A ->
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊩ vctxPairR v C : A1 * A2; A
| vctxTypingInj n (Delta: ctx n) (C: vctx t m n) A A1 A2 (b: bool):
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊩ C : (if b then A1 else A2); A ->
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊩ vctxInj b C : Sigma A1 A2; A
| vctxTypingThunk n (Delta: ctx n) (C: cctx t m n) B A:
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊢ C : B; A ->
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊩ vctxThunk C : U B; A
where "Gamma [[ Delta ]] ⊩ C : A ; T " := (@vctxTyping _ _ Gamma _  Delta C A T)

with cctxTyping {m: nat} {t: bool} (Gamma: ctx m) :
  forall n, ctx n -> cctx t m n -> comptype -> (if t then valtype else comptype) -> Type :=
| cctxTypingHole A H:
    Gamma [[ Gamma ]] ⊢ cctxHole t m H : A; comptypeif t A H
| cctxTypingLambda n (Delta: ctx n) (C: cctx t (S m) n) A A' B:
    (A .: Gamma) [[Delta]] ⊢ C : B; A' ->
      Gamma [[Delta]] ⊢ cctxLambda C : A → B; A'
| cctxTypingForce n (Delta: ctx n) (C: vctx t m n) B A':
    Gamma [[Delta]] ⊩ C : U B; A' ->
    Gamma [[Delta]] ⊢ cctxForce C : B; A'
| cctxTypingAppL n (Delta: ctx n) (C: cctx t m n) A A' B v:
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊢ C : A → B; A' ->
    Gamma ⊩ v : A  ->
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊢ cctxAppL C v : B; A'
| cctxTypingAppR n (Delta: ctx n) c (C: vctx t m n) A A' B :
    Gamma ⊢ c : A → B  ->
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊩ C : A; A' ->
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊢ cctxAppR c C : B; A'
| cctxTypingTupleL n (Delta: ctx n) (C: cctx t m n) B1 B2 A c:
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊢ C : B1; A ->
    Gamma ⊢ c : B2  ->
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊢ cctxTupleL C c : Pi B1 B2; A
| cctxTypingTupleR n (Delta: ctx n) (C: cctx t m n) B1 B2 A c:
    Gamma ⊢ c : B1  ->
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊢ C : B2; A ->
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊢ cctxTupleR c C : Pi B1 B2; A
| cctxTypingRet n (Delta: ctx n) (C: vctx t m n) A A':
    Gamma [[Delta]] ⊩ C : A; A' ->
    Gamma [[Delta]] ⊢ cctxRet C : F A; A'
| cctxTypingLetinL n (Delta: ctx n) (C: cctx t m n) A A' B c:
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊢ C : F A; A' ->
    A .: Gamma ⊢ c : B  ->
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊢ cctxLetinL C c : B; A'
| cctxTypingLetinR n (Delta: ctx n) (C: cctx t (S m) n) A A' B c:
    Gamma ⊢ c : F A  ->
    (A .: Gamma)[[Delta]] ⊢ C : B; A' ->
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊢ cctxLetinR c C : B; A'
| cctxTypingProj n (Delta: ctx n) (C: cctx t m n) A B1 B2 (b: bool):
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊢ C : Pi B1 B2; A ->
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊢ cctxProj b C : (if b then B1 else B2); A
| cctxTypingCaseZ n (Delta: ctx n) (C: vctx t m n) A A':
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊩ C : zero; A' ->
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊢ cctxCaseZ C : A; A'
| cctxTypingCaseSV n (Delta: ctx n) (C: vctx t m n) A1 A2 A' B c1 c2:
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊩ C : Sigma A1 A2; A' ->
    A1 .: Gamma ⊢ c1 : B  ->
    A2 .: Gamma ⊢ c2 : B  ->
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊢ cctxCaseSV C c1 c2 : B; A'
| cctxTypingCaseSL n (Delta: ctx n) (C: cctx t (S m) n) A1 A2 A' B v c2:
    Gamma ⊩ v : Sigma A1 A2  ->
    (A1 .: Gamma)[[Delta]] ⊢ C : B; A' ->
    A2 .: Gamma ⊢ c2 : B  ->
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊢ cctxCaseSL v C c2 : B; A'
| cctxTypingCaseSR n (Delta: ctx n) (C: cctx t (S m) n) A1 A2 A' B v c1:
    Gamma ⊩ v : Sigma A1 A2  ->
    A1 .: Gamma ⊢ c1 : B  ->
    (A2 .: Gamma)[[Delta]] ⊢ C : B; A' ->
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊢ cctxCaseSR v c1 C : B; A'
| cctxTypingCasePV n (Delta: ctx n) (C: vctx t m n) A1 A2 A' B c:
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊩ C : A1 * A2; A' ->
    (A2 .: (A1 .: Gamma)) ⊢ c : B  ->
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊢ cctxCasePV C c : B; A'
| cctxTypingCasePC n (Delta: ctx n) (C: cctx t (S (S m)) n) A1 A2 A' B v:
    Gamma ⊩ v : A1 * A2  ->
    (A2 .: (A1 .: Gamma))[[Delta]] ⊢ C : B; A' ->
    Gamma[[Delta]] ⊢ cctxCasePC v C : B; A'
where "Gamma [[ Delta ]] ⊢ C : B ; T " := (@cctxTyping _ _ Gamma _ Delta C B T).

Scheme vctx_typing_ind_2 := Minimality for vctxTyping Sort Prop
  with cctx_typing_ind_2  := Minimality for cctxTyping Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme mutind_vctx_cctx_typing from
         vctx_typing_ind_2, cctx_typing_ind_2.

Scheme vctx_typing_ind_3 := Induction for vctxTyping Sort Prop
  with cctx_typing_ind_3  := Induction for cctxTyping Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme mutindt_vctx_cctx_typing from
          vctx_typing_ind_3, cctx_typing_ind_3.

Fixpoint plugvctx {m n k: nat} {t1 t2: bool} (C: vctx t1 m n) :
  (if t1 then vctx t2 n k else cctx t2 n k) -> vctx t2 m k :=

Require Import CBPV.SyntacticTyping CBPV.AbstractReductionSystems CBPV.StrongReduction.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Logic List.

Require Import Classes.Morphisms.

Import List Notations.

Require Import FunctionalExtensionality.

Import CommaNotation.

(** * Basic substitution / renaming algebra *)

Definition idsv {n} : fin n -> value n := @ids value VarInstance_value n.

Definition renv {n m} (xi : fin n -> fin m) : fin n -> value m :=
  fun i => @var_value m (xi i).

Definition scomp {n m k} (s : fin n -> value m) (t : fin m -> value k) : fin n -> value k :=
  fun i => (s i)[t].

Lemma up_renv n m (xi : fin n -> fin m) :
  @up_value_value n m (renv xi) = renv (up_ren xi).
Proof.
  apply funext. intros [i|]; cbn. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma up_renv_shift n m (xi : fin n -> fin m) :
  @up_value_value n m (fun i => (renv xi i)⟨shift⟩) = renv (fun i => Some (xi i)).
Proof.
  apply funext. intros [i|]; cbn. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ren_is_subst :
  (forall n (v:value n) m (xi: fin n -> fin m), v⟨xi⟩ = v[renv xi]) /\
  (forall n (c:comp n) m (xi: fin n -> fin m), c⟨xi⟩ = c[renv xi]).
Proof.
  apply mutind_val_comp.
  - intros n i m xi. reflexivity.
  - intros n m xi. reflexivity.
  - intros n v1 v2 IH1 IH2 m xi. cbn. rewrite IH1, IH2. reflexivity.
  - intros n b v IH m xi. cbn. rewrite IH. reflexivity.
  - intros n v IH m xi. cbn. rewrite IH. rewrite up_renv. reflexivity.
  - intros n m xi. reflexivity.
  - intros n v IH m xi. cbn. rewrite IH. reflexivity.
  - intros n c IH m xi. cbn. rewrite IH. rewrite up_renv. reflexivity.
  - intros n c v IH1 IH2 m xi. cbn. rewrite IH1, IH2. reflexivity.
  - intros n c1 c2 IH1 IH2 m xi. cbn. rewrite IH1, IH2. reflexivity.
  - intros n v IH m xi. cbn. rewrite IH. reflexivity.
  - intros n c1 c2 IH1 IH2 m xi. cbn. rewrite IH1, IH2. rewrite up_renv. reflexivity.
  - intros n b c IH m xi. cbn. rewrite IH. reflexivity.
  - intros n v IH m xi. cbn. rewrite IH. reflexivity.
  - intros n v c1 c2 IH1 IH2 m xi. cbn. rewrite IH1, IH2. rewrite up_renv. reflexivity.
  - intros n v c IH m xi. cbn. rewrite IH. rewrite up_renv, up_renv. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ren_value_subst (n:nat) (v:value n) m (xi: fin n -> fin m) k (t: fin m -> value k) :
  (v⟨xi⟩)[t] = v[scomp (renv xi) t].
Proof.
  rewrite (proj1 ren_is_subst). Abort.

  fun i => @var_value m (xi i).

Definition scomp {n m k} (s : fin n -> value m) (t : fin m -> value k) : fin n -> value k :=
  fun i => (s i)[t].

(** Pointwise equality of substitutions is respected. *)
Lemma subst_ext :
  (forall n (v:value n) m (s t : fin n -> value m),
      (forall i, s i = t i) -> v[s] = v[t]) /\
  (forall n (c:comp n) m (s t : fin n -> value m),
      (forall i, s i = t i) -> c[s] = c[t]).
Proof.
  apply mutind_val_comp.
  - intros n i m s t H. cbn. apply H.
  - intros n m s t H. reflexivity.
  - intros n v1 v2 IH1 IH2 m s t H. cbn. rewrite IH1; auto. rewrite IH2; auto.
  - intros n b v IH m s t H. cbn. rewrite IH; auto.
  - intros n v IH m s t H. cbn. rewrite IH.
    2: { intros [i|]; cbn; auto. }
    reflexivity.
  - intros n m s t H. reflexivity.
  - intros n v IH m s t H. cbn. rewrite IH; auto.
  - intros n c IH m s t H. cbn. rewrite IH.
    2: { intros [i|]; cbn; auto. }
    reflexivity.
  - intros n c v IH1 IH2 m s t H. cbn. rewrite IH1; auto. rewrite IH2; auto.
  - intros n c1 c2 IH1 IH2 m s t H. cbn. rewrite IH1; auto. rewrite IH2; auto.
  - intros n v IH m s t H. cbn. rewrite IH; auto.
  - intros n c1 c2 IH1 IH2 m s t H. cbn. rewrite IH1; auto. rewrite IH2.
    2: { intros [i|]; cbn; auto. }
    reflexivity.
  - intros n b c IH m s t H. cbn. rewrite IH; auto.
  - intros n v IH m s t H. cbn. rewrite IH; auto.
  - intros n v c1 c2 IH1 IH2 m s t H. cbn. rewrite IH1; auto. rewrite IH2.
    2: { intros [i|]; cbn; auto. }
    reflexivity.
  - intros n v c IH m s t H. cbn. rewrite IH.
    2: { intros [[i|]|]; cbn; auto. }
    reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ren_ext :
  (forall n (v:value n) m (xi zeta : fin n -> fin m),
      (forall i, xi i = zeta i) -> v⟨xi⟩ = v⟨zeta⟩) /\
  (forall n (c:comp n) m (xi zeta : fin n -> fin m),
      (forall i, xi i = zeta i) -> c⟨xi⟩ = c⟨zeta⟩).
Proof.
  apply mutind_val_comp.

  - intros n m xi zeta H. reflexivity.
  - intros n v IH m xi zeta H. cbn. rewrite IH; auto.
  - intros n c IH m xi zeta H. cbn. rewrite IH.
    2: { intros [i|]; cbn; auto. }
    reflexivity.
  - intros n c v IH1 IH2 m xi zeta H. cbn. rewrite IH1; auto. rewrite IH2; auto.
  - intros n c1 c2 IH1 IH2 m xi zeta H. cbn. rewrite IH1; auto. rewrite IH2; auto.
  - intros n v IH m xi zeta H. cbn. rewrite IH; auto.
  - intros n c1 c2 IH1 IH2 m xi zeta H. cbn. rewrite IH1; auto. rewrite IH2.
    2: { intros [i|]; cbn; auto. }
    reflexivity.
  - intros n b c IH m xi zeta H. cbn. rewrite IH; auto.
  - intros n v IH m xi zeta H. cbn. rewrite IH; auto.
  - intros n v c1 c2 IH1 IH2 m xi zeta H. cbn. rewrite IH1; auto. rewrite IH2.
    2: { intros [i|]; cbn; auto. }
    reflexivity.
  - intros n v c IH m xi zeta H. cbn. rewrite IH.
    2: { intros [[i|]|]; cbn; auto. }
    reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma up_renv n m (xi: fin n -> fin m) i :
  @up_value_value n m (renv xi) i = renv (up_ren xi) i.
Proof. destruct i as [i|]; cbn. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma ren_is_subst :
  (forall n (v:value n) m (xi: fin n -> fin m), v⟨xi⟩ = v[renv xi]) /\
  (forall n (c:comp n) m (xi: fin n -> fin m), c⟨xi⟩ = c[renv xi]).
Proof.
  apply mutind_val_comp.
  - intros n i m xi. reflexivity.
  - intros n m xi. reflexivity.
  - intros n v1 v2 IH1 IH2 m xi. cbn. rewrite IH1, IH2. reflexivity.

    rewrite (proj2 subst_ext (up_value_value (up_value_value (renv xi))) (renv (up_ren (up_ren xi)))).

Require Import CBPV.SyntacticTyping CBPV.AbstractReductionSystems CBPV.StrongReduction.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Logic List.

Require Import Classes.Morphisms.

Import List Notations.

Import CommaNotation.

(** * Basic substitution / renaming algebra *)

Definition idsv {n} : fin n -> value n := @ids value VarInstance_value n.

Definition renv {n m} (xi : fin n -> fin m) : fin n -> value m :=
  fun i => @var_value m (xi i).

Definition scomp {n m k} (s : fin n -> value m) (t : fin m -> value k) : fin n -> value k :=
  fun i => (s i)[t].

(** Pointwise equality of substitutions is respected. *)
Lemma subst_ext :
  (forall n (v:value n) m (s t : fin n -> value m),
      (forall i, s i = t i) -> v[s] = v[t]) /\
  (forall n (c:comp n) m (s t : fin n -> value m),
      (forall i, s i = t i) -> c[s] = c[t]).
Proof.
  apply mutind_val_comp.
  - intros n i m s t H. cbn. apply H.
  - intros n m s t H. reflexivity.
  - intros n v1 v2 IH1 IH2 m s t H. cbn. rewrite IH1; auto. rewrite IH2; auto.
  - intros n b v IH m s t H. cbn. rewrite IH; auto.
  - intros n v IH m s t H. cbn. rewrite IH.
    2: { intros [i|]; cbn; auto. }
    reflexivity.
  - intros n m s t H. reflexivity.
  - intros n v IH m s t H. cbn. rewrite IH; auto.
  - intros n c IH m s t H. cbn. rewrite IH.
    2: { intros [i|]; cbn; auto. }
    reflexivity.
  - intros n c v IH1 IH2 m s t H. cbn. rewrite IH1; auto. rewrite IH2; auto.
  - intros n c1 c2 IH1 IH2 m s t H. cbn. rewrite IH1; auto. rewrite IH2; auto.
  - intros n v IH m s t H. cbn. rewrite IH; auto.
  - intros n c1 c2 IH1 IH2 m s t H. cbn. rewrite IH1; auto. rewrite IH2.
    2: { intros [i|]; cbn; auto. }
    reflexivity.
  - intros n b c IH m s t H. cbn. rewrite IH; auto.
  - intros n v IH m s t H. cbn. rewrite IH; auto.
  - intros n v c1 c2 IH1 IH2 m s t H. cbn. rewrite IH1; auto. rewrite IH2.
    2: { intros [i|]; cbn; auto. }
    reflexivity.
  - intros n v c IH m s t H. cbn. rewrite IH.
    2: { intros [[i|]|]; cbn; auto. }
    reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ren_ext :
  (forall n (v:value n) m (xi zeta : fin n -> fin m),
      (forall i, xi i = zeta i) -> v⟨xi⟩ = v⟨zeta⟩) /\
  (forall n (c:comp n) m (xi zeta : fin n -> fin m),
      (forall i, xi i = zeta i) -> c⟨xi⟩ = c⟨zeta⟩).
Proof.
  apply mutind_val_comp.
  - intros n i m xi zeta H. cbn. apply H.
  - intros n m xi zeta H. reflexivity.
  - intros n v1 v2 IH1 IH2 m xi zeta H. cbn. rewrite IH1; auto. rewrite IH2; auto.
  - intros n b v IH m xi zeta H. cbn. rewrite IH; auto.
  - intros n v IH m xi zeta H. cbn. rewrite IH.
    2: { intros [i|]; cbn; auto. }
    reflexivity.
  - intros n m xi zeta H. reflexivity.
  - intros n v IH m xi zeta H. cbn. rewrite IH; auto.
  - intros n c IH m xi zeta H. cbn. rewrite IH.
    2: { intros [i|]; cbn; auto. }
    reflexivity.
  - intros n c v IH1 IH2 m xi zeta H. cbn. rewrite IH1; auto. rewrite IH2; auto.
  - intros n c1 c2 IH1 IH2 m xi zeta H. cbn. rewrite IH1; auto. rewrite IH2; auto.
  - intros n v IH m xi zeta H. cbn. rewrite IH; auto.
  - intros n c1 c2 IH1 IH2 m xi zeta H. cbn. rewrite IH1; auto. rewrite IH2.
    2: { intros [i|]; cbn; auto. }
    reflexivity.
  - intros n b c IH m xi zeta H. cbn. rewrite IH; auto.
  - intros n v IH m xi zeta H. cbn. rewrite IH; auto.
  - intros n v c1 c2 IH1 IH2 m xi zeta H. cbn. rewrite IH1; auto. rewrite IH2.
    2: { intros [i|]; cbn; auto. }
    reflexivity.
  - intros n v c IH m xi zeta H. cbn. rewrite IH.
    2: { intros [[i|]|]; cbn; auto. }
    reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma up_renv n m (xi: fin n -> fin m) i :
  @up_value_value n m (renv xi) i = renv (up_ren xi) i.
Proof. destruct i as [i|]; cbn. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma ren_is_subst :
  (forall n (v:value n) m (xi: fin n -> fin m), v⟨xi⟩ = v[renv xi]) /\
  (forall n (c:comp n) m (xi: fin n -> fin m), c⟨xi⟩ = c[renv xi]).
Proof.
  apply mutind_val_comp.
  - intros n i m xi. reflexivity.
  - intros n m xi. reflexivity.
  - intros n v1 v2 IH1 IH2 m xi. cbn. rewrite IH1, IH2. reflexivity.
  - intros n b v IH m xi. cbn. rewrite IH. reflexivity.
  - intros n v IH m xi. cbn. rewrite IH. rewrite (proj1 subst_ext (up_value_value (renv xi)) (renv (up_ren xi))).
    2: apply up_renv.
    reflexivity.
  - intros n m xi. reflexivity.
  - intros n v IH m xi. cbn. rewrite IH. reflexivity.
  - intros n c IH m xi. cbn. rewrite IH. rewrite (proj2 subst_ext (up_value_value (renv xi)) (renv (up_ren xi))).
    2: apply up_renv.
    reflexivity.
  - intros n c v IH1 IH2 m xi. cbn. rewrite IH1, IH2. reflexivity.
  - intros n c1 c2 IH1 IH2 m xi. cbn. rewrite IH1, IH2. reflexivity.
  - intros n v IH m xi. cbn. rewrite IH. reflexivity.
  - intros n c1 c2 IH1 IH2 m xi. cbn. rewrite IH1, IH2.
    rewrite (proj2 subst_ext (up_value_value (renv xi)) (renv (up_ren xi))).
    2: apply up_renv.
    reflexivity.
  - intros n b c IH m xi. cbn. rewrite IH. reflexivity.
  - intros n v IH m xi. cbn. rewrite IH. reflexivity.
  - intros n v c1 c2 IH1 IH2 m xi. cbn. rewrite IH1, IH2.
    rewrite (proj2 subst_ext (up_value_value (renv xi)) (renv (up_ren xi))).
    2: apply up_renv.
    reflexivity.
  - intros n v c IH m xi. cbn. rewrite IH.
    rewrite (proj2 subst_ext (up_value_value (up_value_value (renv xi))) (renv (up_ren (up_ren xi)))).
    2: { intros [[i|]|]; cbn; apply up_renv. }
    reflexivity.
Qed.

Require Import CBPV.SyntacticTyping CBPV.AbstractReductionSystems CBPV.StrongReduction.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Logic List.

Require Import Classes.Morphisms.

Import List Notations.

Require Import FunctionalExtensionality.

Import CommaNotation.

(** * Basic substitution / renaming algebra *)

Definition idsv {n} : fin n -> value n := @ids value VarInstance_value n.

Definition renv {n m} (xi : fin n -> fin m) : fin n -> value m :=
  fun i => @var_value m (xi i).

Definition scomp {n m k} (s : fin n -> value m) (t : fin m -> value k) : fin n -> value k :=
  fun i => (s i)[t].

Lemma up_renv n m (xi : fin n -> fin m) :
  @up_value_value n m (renv xi) = renv (up_ren xi).
Proof.
  apply funext. intros [i|]; cbn. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma up_renv_shift n m (xi : fin n -> fin m) :
  @up_value_value n m (fun i => (renv xi i)⟨shift⟩) = renv (fun i => Some (xi i)).
Proof.
  apply funext. intros [i|]; cbn. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ren_is_subst :
  (forall n (v:value n) m (xi: fin n -> fin m), v⟨xi⟩ = v[renv xi]) /\
  (forall n (c:comp n) m (xi: fin n -> fin m), c⟨xi⟩ = c[renv xi]).
Proof.
  apply mutind_val_comp.
  - intros n i m xi. reflexivity.
  - intros n m xi. reflexivity.
  - intros n v1 v2 IH1 IH2 m xi. cbn. rewrite IH1, IH2. reflexivity.
  - intros n b v IH m xi. cbn. rewrite IH. reflexivity.
  - intros n v IH m xi. cbn. rewrite IH. rewrite up_renv. reflexivity.
  - intros n m xi. reflexivity.
  - intros n v IH m xi. cbn. rewrite IH. reflexivity.
  - intros n c IH m xi. cbn. rewrite IH. rewrite up_renv. reflexivity.
  - intros n c v IH1 IH2 m xi. cbn. rewrite IH1, IH2. reflexivity.
  - intros n c1 c2 IH1 IH2 m xi. cbn. rewrite IH1, IH2. reflexivity.
  - intros n v IH m xi. cbn. rewrite IH. reflexivity.
  - intros n c1 c2 IH1 IH2 m xi. cbn. rewrite IH1, IH2. rewrite up_renv. reflexivity.
  - intros n b c IH m xi. cbn. rewrite IH. reflexivity.
  - intros n v IH m xi. cbn. rewrite IH. reflexivity.
  - intros n v c1 c2 IH1 IH2 m xi. cbn. rewrite IH1, IH2. rewrite up_renv. reflexivity.
  - intros n v c IH m xi. cbn. rewrite IH. rewrite up_renv, up_renv. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ren_value_subst (n:nat) (v:value n) m (xi: fin n -> fin m) k (t: fin m -> value k) :
  (v⟨xi⟩)[t] = v[scomp (renv xi) t].
Proof.
  rewrite (proj1 ren_is_subst). Abort.

  - intros n c IH m s t H. cbn. rewrite IH.

Require Import CBPV.SyntacticTyping CBPV.AbstractReductionSystems CBPV.StrongReduction.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Logic List.

Require Import Classes.Morphisms.

Import List Notations.

Import CommaNotation.

(** * Basic substitution / renaming algebra *)

Definition idsv {n} : fin n -> value n := @ids value VarInstance_value n.

Definition renv {n m} (xi : fin n -> fin m) : fin n -> value m :=
  fun i => @var_value m (xi i).

Definition scomp {n m k} (s : fin n -> value m) (t : fin m -> value k) : fin n -> value k :=
  fun i => (s i)[t].

Definition sren {n m k} (s : fin n -> value m) (xi : fin m -> fin k) : fin n -> value k :=
  fun i => (s i)⟨xi⟩.

Definition rscomp {n m k} (xi : fin n -> fin m) (s : fin m -> value k) : fin n -> value k :=
  fun i => s (xi i).

(** Pointwise equality of substitutions is respected. *)
Lemma subst_ext :

Require Import CBPV.SyntacticTyping CBPV.AbstractReductionSystems CBPV.StrongReduction.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Logic List.

Require Import Classes.Morphisms.

Import List Notations.

Import CommaNotation.

(** * Basic substitution / renaming algebra *)

Definition idsv {n} : fin n -> value n := @ids value VarInstance_value n.

Definition renv {n m} (xi : fin n -> fin m) : fin n -> value m :=
  fun i => @var_value m (xi i).

Definition scomp {n m k} (s : fin n -> value m) (t : fin m -> value k) : fin n -> value k :=
  fun i => (s i)[t].

Definition sren {n m k} (s : fin n -> value m) (xi : fin m -> fin k) : fin n -> value k :=
  fun i => (s i)⟨xi⟩.

Definition rscomp {n m k} (xi : fin n -> fin m) (s : fin m -> value k) : fin n -> value k :=
  fun i => s (xi i).

(** Pointwise equality of substitutions is respected. *)
Lemma subst_ext n :
  (forall (v:value n) m (s t : fin n -> value m),
      (forall i, s i = t i) -> v[s] = v[t]) /\
  (forall (c:comp n) m (s t : fin n -> value m),
      (forall i, s i = t i) -> c[s] = c[t]).
Proof.
  apply (mutind_val_comp
    (fun n (v:value n) => forall m (s t: fin n -> value m), (forall i, s i = t i) -> v[s] = v[t])
    (fun n (c:comp n) => forall m (s t: fin n -> value m), (forall i, s i = t i) -> c[s] = c[t])).
  - intros i m s t H. cbn. apply H.
  - intros m s t H. reflexivity.
  - intros v1 v2 IH1 IH2 m s t H. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2]; auto.
  - intros b v IH m s t H. cbn. f_equal. apply IH; auto.
  - intros v IH m s t H. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
    intros [i|]; cbn. reflexivity. rewrite H. reflexivity.
  - intros m s t H. reflexivity.
  - intros v IH m s t H. cbn. f_equal. apply IH; auto.
  - intros c IH m s t H. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
    intros [i|]; cbn. reflexivity. rewrite H. reflexivity.
  - intros c v IH1 IH2 m s t H. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2]; auto.
  - intros c1 c2 IH1 IH2 m s t H. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2]; auto.
  - intros v IH m s t H. cbn. f_equal. apply IH; auto.
  - intros c1 c2 IH1 IH2 m s t H. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2]; auto.
  - intros b c IH m s t H. cbn. f_equal. apply IH; auto.
  - intros v IH m s t H. cbn. f_equal. apply IH; auto.
  - intros v c1 c2 IH1 IH2 m s t H. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2]; auto.
  - intros v c IH m s t H. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
    intros [[i|]|]; cbn; auto; rewrite H; reflexivity.
Qed.

(** Pointwise equality of renamings is respected. *)
Lemma ren_ext n :
  (forall (v:value n) m (xi zeta : fin n -> fin m),
      (forall i, xi i = zeta i) -> v⟨xi⟩ = v⟨zeta⟩) /\
  (forall (c:comp n) m (xi zeta : fin n -> fin m),
      (forall i, xi i = zeta i) -> c⟨xi⟩ = c⟨zeta⟩).
Proof.
  apply (mutind_val_comp
    (fun n (v:value n) => forall m (xi zeta: fin n -> fin m), (forall i, xi i = zeta i) -> v⟨xi⟩ = v⟨zeta⟩)
    (fun n (c:comp n) => forall m (xi zeta: fin n -> fin m), (forall i, xi i = zeta i) -> c⟨xi⟩ = c⟨zeta⟩)).
  - intros i m xi zeta H. cbn. apply H.
  - intros m xi zeta H. reflexivity.
  - intros v1 v2 IH1 IH2 m xi zeta H. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2]; auto.
  - intros b v IH m xi zeta H. cbn. f_equal. apply IH; auto.
  - intros v IH m xi zeta H. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
    intros [i|]; cbn. reflexivity. rewrite H. reflexivity.
  - intros m xi zeta H. reflexivity.
  - intros v IH m xi zeta H. cbn. f_equal. apply IH; auto.
  - intros c IH m xi zeta H. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
    intros [i|]; cbn. reflexivity. rewrite H. reflexivity.
  - intros c v IH1 IH2 m xi zeta H. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2]; auto.
  - intros c1 c2 IH1 IH2 m xi zeta H. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2]; auto.
  - intros v IH m xi zeta H. cbn. f_equal. apply IH; auto.
  - intros c1 c2 IH1 IH2 m xi zeta H. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2]; auto.
  - intros b c IH m xi zeta H. cbn. f_equal. apply IH; auto.
  - intros v IH m xi zeta H. cbn. f_equal. apply IH; auto.
  - intros v c1 c2 IH1 IH2 m xi zeta H. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2]; auto.
  - intros v c IH m xi zeta H. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
    intros [[i|]|]; cbn; auto; rewrite H; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ren_is_subst n :
  (forall (v:value n) m (xi: fin n -> fin m), v⟨xi⟩ = v[renv xi]) /\
  (forall (c:comp n) m (xi: fin n -> fin m), c⟨xi⟩ = c[renv xi]).
Proof.
  apply (mutind_val_comp
    (fun n (v:value n) => forall m (xi: fin n -> fin m), v⟨xi⟩ = v[renv xi])
    (fun n (c:comp n) => forall m (xi: fin n -> fin m), c⟨xi⟩ = c[renv xi])).
  - intros i m xi. reflexivity.
  - intros m xi. reflexivity.
  - intros v1 v2 IH1 IH2 m xi. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2].
  - intros b v IH m xi. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros v IH m xi. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros m xi. reflexivity.
  - intros v IH m xi. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros c IH m xi. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros c v IH1 IH2 m xi. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2].
  - intros c1 c2 IH1 IH2 m xi. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2].
  - intros v IH m xi. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros c1 c2 IH1 IH2 m xi. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2].
  - intros b c IH m xi. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros v IH m xi. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros v c1 c2 IH1 IH2 m xi. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2].
  - intros v c IH m xi. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
Qed.

Lemma ren_subst n :
  (forall (v:value n) m (xi: ren n m) k (s: fin m -> value k),
      (v⟨xi⟩)[s] = v[rscomp xi s]) /\
  (forall (c:comp n) m (xi: ren n m) k (s: fin m -> value k),
      (c⟨xi⟩)[s] = c[rscomp xi s]).
Proof.
  apply (mutind_val_comp
    (fun n (v:value n) => forall m (xi: ren n m) k (s: fin m -> value k), (v⟨xi⟩)[s] = v[rscomp xi s])
    (fun n (c:comp n) => forall m (xi: ren n m) k (s: fin m -> value k), (c⟨xi⟩)[s] = c[rscomp xi s])).
  - intros i m xi k s. reflexivity.
  - intros m xi k s. reflexivity.
  - intros v1 v2 IH1 IH2 m xi k s. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2].
  - intros b v IH m xi k s. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros v IH m xi k s. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros m xi k s. reflexivity.
  - intros v IH m xi k s. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros c IH m xi k s. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
    intros [i|]; cbn. reflexivity. reflexivity.
  - intros c v IH1 IH2 m xi k s. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2].
  - intros c1 c2 IH1 IH2 m xi k s. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2].
  - intros v IH m xi k s. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros c1 c2 IH1 IH2 m xi k s. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2].
  - intros b c IH m xi k s. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros v IH m xi k s. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros v c1 c2 IH1 IH2 m xi k s. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2].
  - intros v c IH m xi k s. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
    intros [[i|]|]; cbn; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subst_ren n :
  (forall (v:value n) m (s: fin n -> value m) k (xi: ren m k),
      (v[s])⟨xi⟩ = v[sren s xi]) /\
  (forall (c:comp n) m (s: fin n -> value m) k (xi: ren m k),
      (c[s])⟨xi⟩ = c[sren s xi]).
Proof.
  apply (mutind_val_comp
    (fun n (v:value n) => forall m (s: fin n -> value m) k (xi: ren m k), (v[s])⟨xi⟩ = v[sren s xi])
    (fun n (c:comp n) => forall m (s: fin n -> value m) k (xi: ren m k), (c[s])⟨xi⟩ = c[sren s xi])).
  - intros i m s k xi. reflexivity.
  - intros m s k xi. reflexivity.
  - intros v1 v2 IH1 IH2 m s k xi. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2].
  - intros b v IH m s k xi. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros v IH m s k xi. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros m s k xi. reflexivity.
  - intros v IH m s k xi. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros c IH m s k xi. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
    intros [i|]; cbn. reflexivity.
    apply (proj2 (ren_ext (S n))); intros j; cbn. reflexivity.
  - intros c v IH1 IH2 m s k xi. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2].
  - intros c1 c2 IH1 IH2 m s k xi. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2].
  - intros v IH m s k xi. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros c1 c2 IH1 IH2 m s k xi. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2].
  - intros b c IH m s k xi. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros v IH m s k xi. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros v c1 c2 IH1 IH2 m s k xi. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2].
  - intros v c IH m s k xi. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
    intros [[i|]|]; cbn. reflexivity.
    apply (proj2 (ren_ext (S (S n)))); intros j; cbn. reflexivity.
    apply (proj2 (ren_ext (S (S n)))); intros j; cbn. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subst_subst n :
  (forall (v:value n) m (s: fin n -> value m) k (t: fin m -> value k),
      (v[s])[t] = v[scomp s t]) /\
  (forall (c:comp n) m (s: fin n -> value m) k (t: fin m -> value k),
      (c[s])[t] = c[scomp s t]).
Proof.
  apply (mutind_val_comp
    (fun n (v:value n) => forall m (s: fin n -> value m) k (t: fin m -> value k), (v[s])[t] = v[scomp s t])
    (fun n (c:comp n) => forall m (s: fin n -> value m) k (t: fin m -> value k), (c[s])[t] = c[scomp s t])).
  - intros i m s k t. reflexivity.
  - intros m s k t. reflexivity.
  - intros v1 v2 IH1 IH2 m s k t. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2].
  - intros b v IH m s k t. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros v IH m s k t. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros m s k t. reflexivity.
  - intros v IH m s k t. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros c IH m s k t. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
    intros [i|]; cbn. reflexivity.
    rewrite (proj1 (ren_subst (S n)) (v:=s i) (xi:=shift) (s:=@up_value_value m k t)).
    rewrite (proj1 (subst_ren (S n)) (v:=s i) (s:=t) (xi:=shift)).
    apply (proj1 (subst_ext (S n))). intros j. reflexivity.
  - intros c v IH1 IH2 m s k t. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2].
  - intros c1 c2 IH1 IH2 m s k t. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2].
  - intros v IH m s k t. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros c1 c2 IH1 IH2 m s k t. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2].
  - intros b c IH m s k t. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros v IH m s k t. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros v c1 c2 IH1 IH2 m s k t. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2].
  - intros v c IH m s k t. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
    intros [[i|]|]; cbn. reflexivity.
    rewrite (proj2 (ren_subst (S (S n))) (v:=s i) (xi:=shift) (s:=@up_value_value (S n) k t)).
    rewrite (proj2 (subst_ren (S (S n))) (v:=s i) (s:=t) (xi:=shift)).
    apply (proj2 (subst_ext (S (S n)))). intros j. reflexivity.
    rewrite (proj2 (ren_subst (S (S n))) (v:=s i) (xi:=shift) (s:=@up_value_value (S n) k t)).
    rewrite (proj2 (subst_ren (S (S n))) (v:=s i) (s:=t) (xi:=shift)).
    apply (proj2 (subst_ext (S (S n)))). intros j. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subst_ids n : (forall (v:value n), v[idsv] = v) /\ (forall (c:comp n), c[idsv] = c).
Proof.
  apply (mutind_val_comp (fun n (v:value n) => v[idsv] = v) (fun n (c:comp n) => c[idsv] = c)).
  - intros i. reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - intros v1 v2 IH1 IH2. cbn. f_equal; auto.
  - intros b v IH. cbn. f_equal; auto.
  - intros v IH. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - reflexivity.
  - intros v IH. cbn. f_equal; auto.
  - intros c IH. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros c v IH1 IH2. cbn. f_equal; auto.
  - intros c1 c2 IH1 IH2. cbn. f_equal; auto.
  - intros v IH. cbn. f_equal; auto.
  - intros c1 c2 IH1 IH2. cbn. f_equal; auto.
  - intros b c IH. cbn. f_equal; auto.
  - intros v IH. cbn. f_equal; auto.
  - intros v c1 c2 IH1 IH2. cbn. f_equal; auto.
  - intros v c IH. cbn. f_equal.
    apply IH. intros [[i|]|]; cbn; reflexivity.
Qed.

Require Import CBPV.SyntacticTyping CBPV.AbstractReductionSystems CBPV.StrongReduction.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Logic List.

Require Import Classes.Morphisms.

Import List Notations.

Import CommaNotation.

(** * Basic substitution / renaming algebra *)

Definition idsv {n} : fin n -> value n := @ids value VarInstance_value n.

Definition renv {n m} (xi : fin n -> fin m) : fin n -> value m :=
  fun i => @var_value m (xi i).

Definition scomp {n m k} (s : fin n -> value m) (t : fin m -> value k) : fin n -> value k :=
  fun i => (s i)[t].

Definition sren {n m k} (s : fin n -> value m) (xi : fin m -> fin k) : fin n -> value k :=
  fun i => (s i)⟨xi⟩.

Definition rscomp {n m k} (xi : fin n -> fin m) (s : fin m -> value k) : fin n -> value k :=
  fun i => s (xi i).

(** Pointwise equality of substitutions is respected. *)
Lemma subst_ext n :
  (forall (v:value n) m (s t : fin n -> value m),
      (forall i, s i = t i) -> v[s] = v[t]) /\
  (forall (c:comp n) m (s t : fin n -> value m),
      (forall i, s i = t i) -> c[s] = c[t]).
Proof.
  apply (mutind_val_comp
    (fun n (v:value n) => forall m (s t: fin n -> value m), (forall i, s i = t i) -> v[s] = v[t])
    (fun n (c:comp n) => forall m (s t: fin n -> value m), (forall i, s i = t i) -> c[s] = c[t])).
  - intros i m s t H. cbn. apply H.
  - intros m s t H. reflexivity.
  - intros v1 v2 IH1 IH2 m s t H. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2]; auto.
  - intros b v IH m s t H. cbn. f_equal. apply IH; auto.
  - intros v IH m s t H. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
    intros [i|]; cbn. reflexivity. rewrite H. reflexivity.
  - intros m s t H. reflexivity.
  - intros v IH m s t H. cbn. f_equal. apply IH; auto.
  - intros c IH m s t H. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
    intros [i|]; cbn. reflexivity. rewrite H. reflexivity.
  - intros c v IH1 IH2 m s t H. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2]; auto.
  - intros c1 c2 IH1 IH2 m s t H. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2]; auto.
  - intros v IH m s t H. cbn. f_equal. apply IH; auto.
  - intros c1 c2 IH1 IH2 m s t H. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2]; auto.
  - intros b c IH m s t H. cbn. f_equal. apply IH; auto.
  - intros v IH m s t H. cbn. f_equal. apply IH; auto.
  - intros v c1 c2 IH1 IH2 m s t H. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2]; auto.
  - intros v c IH m s t H. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
    intros [[i|]|]; cbn; auto; rewrite H; reflexivity.
Qed.

(** Pointwise equality of renamings is respected. *)
Lemma ren_ext n :
  (forall (v:value n) m (xi zeta : fin n -> fin m),
      (forall i, xi i = zeta i) -> v⟨xi⟩ = v⟨zeta⟩) /\
  (forall (c:comp n) m (xi zeta : fin n -> fin m),
      (forall i, xi i = zeta i) -> c⟨xi⟩ = c⟨zeta⟩).
Proof.
  apply (mutind_val_comp
    (fun n (v:value n) => forall m (xi zeta: fin n -> fin m), (forall i, xi i = zeta i) -> v⟨xi⟩ = v⟨zeta⟩)
    (fun n (c:comp n) => forall m (xi zeta: fin n -> fin m), (forall i, xi i = zeta i) -> c⟨xi⟩ = c⟨zeta⟩)).
  - intros i m xi zeta H. cbn. apply H.
  - intros m xi zeta H. reflexivity.
  - intros v1 v2 IH1 IH2 m xi zeta H. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2]; auto.
  - intros b v IH m xi zeta H. cbn. f_equal. apply IH; auto.
  - intros v IH m xi zeta H. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
    intros [i|]; cbn. reflexivity. rewrite H. reflexivity.
  - intros m xi zeta H. reflexivity.
  - intros v IH m xi zeta H. cbn. f_equal. apply IH; auto.
  - intros c IH m xi zeta H. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
    intros [i|]; cbn. reflexivity. rewrite H. reflexivity.
  - intros c v IH1 IH2 m xi zeta H. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2]; auto.
  - intros c1 c2 IH1 IH2 m xi zeta H. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2]; auto.
  - intros v IH m xi zeta H. cbn. f_equal. apply IH; auto.
  - intros c1 c2 IH1 IH2 m xi zeta H. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2]; auto.
  - intros b c IH m xi zeta H. cbn. f_equal. apply IH; auto.
  - intros v IH m xi zeta H. cbn. f_equal. apply IH; auto.
  - intros v c1 c2 IH1 IH2 m xi zeta H. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2]; auto.
  - intros v c IH m xi zeta H. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
    intros [[i|]|]; cbn; auto; rewrite H; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ren_is_subst n :
  (forall (v:value n) m (xi: fin n -> fin m), v⟨xi⟩ = v[renv xi]) /\
  (forall (c:comp n) m (xi: fin n -> fin m), c⟨xi⟩ = c[renv xi]).
Proof.
  apply (mutind_val_comp
    (fun n (v:value n) => forall m (xi: fin n -> fin m), v⟨xi⟩ = v[renv xi])
    (fun n (c:comp n) => forall m (xi: fin n -> fin m), c⟨xi⟩ = c[renv xi])).
  - intros i m xi. reflexivity.
  - intros m xi. reflexivity.
  - intros v1 v2 IH1 IH2 m xi. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2].
  - intros b v IH m xi. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros v IH m xi. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros m xi. reflexivity.
  - intros v IH m xi. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros c IH m xi. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros c v IH1 IH2 m xi. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2].
  - intros c1 c2 IH1 IH2 m xi. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2].
  - intros v IH m xi. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros c1 c2 IH1 IH2 m xi. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2].
  - intros b c IH m xi. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros v IH m xi. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros v c1 c2 IH1 IH2 m xi. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2].
  - intros v c IH m xi. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
Qed.

Lemma ren_subst n :
  (forall (v:value n) m (xi: ren n m) k (s: fin m -> value k),
      (v⟨xi⟩)[s] = v[rscomp xi s]) /\
  (forall (c:comp n) m (xi: ren n m) k (s: fin m -> value k),
      (c⟨xi⟩)[s] = c[rscomp xi s]).
Proof.
  apply (mutind_val_comp
    (fun n (v:value n) => forall m (xi: ren n m) k (s: fin m -> value k), (v⟨xi⟩)[s] = v[rscomp xi s])
    (fun n (c:comp n) => forall m (xi: ren n m) k (s: fin m -> value k), (c⟨xi⟩)[s] = c[rscomp xi s])).
  - intros i m xi k s. reflexivity.
  - intros m xi k s. reflexivity.
  - intros v1 v2 IH1 IH2 m xi k s. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2].
  - intros b v IH m xi k s. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros v IH m xi k s. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros m xi k s. reflexivity.
  - intros v IH m xi k s. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros c IH m xi k s. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
    intros [i|]; cbn. reflexivity. reflexivity.
  - intros c v IH1 IH2 m xi k s. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2].
  - intros c1 c2 IH1 IH2 m xi k s. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2].
  - intros v IH m xi k s. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros c1 c2 IH1 IH2 m xi k s. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2].
  - intros b c IH m xi k s. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros v IH m xi k s. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros v c1 c2 IH1 IH2 m xi k s. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2].
  - intros v c IH m xi k s. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
    intros [[i|]|]; cbn; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subst_ren n :
  (forall (v:value n) m (s: fin n -> value m) k (xi: ren m k),
      (v[s])⟨xi⟩ = v[sren s xi]) /\
  (forall (c:comp n) m (s: fin n -> value m) k (xi: ren m k),
      (c[s])⟨xi⟩ = c[sren s xi]).
Proof.
  apply (mutind_val_comp
    (fun n (v:value n) => forall m (s: fin n -> value m) k (xi: ren m k), (v[s])⟨xi⟩ = v[sren s xi])
    (fun n (c:comp n) => forall m (s: fin n -> value m) k (xi: ren m k), (c[s])⟨xi⟩ = c[sren s xi])).
  - intros i m s k xi. reflexivity.
  - intros m s k xi. reflexivity.
  - intros v1 v2 IH1 IH2 m s k xi. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2].
  - intros b v IH m s k xi. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros v IH m s k xi. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros m s k xi. reflexivity.
  - intros v IH m s k xi. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros c IH m s k xi. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
    intros [i|]; cbn. reflexivity.
    apply (proj2 (ren_ext (S n))); intros j; cbn. reflexivity.
  - intros c v IH1 IH2 m s k xi. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2].
  - intros c1 c2 IH1 IH2 m s k xi. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2].
  - intros v IH m s k xi. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros c1 c2 IH1 IH2 m s k xi. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2].
  - intros b c IH m s k xi. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros v IH m s k xi. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros v c1 c2 IH1 IH2 m s k xi. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2].
  - intros v c IH m s k xi. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
    intros [[i|]|]; cbn. reflexivity.
    apply (proj2 (ren_ext (S (S n)))); intros j; cbn. reflexivity.
    apply (proj2 (ren_ext (S (S n)))); intros j; cbn. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subst_subst n :
  (forall (v:value n) m (s: fin n -> value m) k (t: fin m -> value k),
      (v[s])[t] = v[scomp s t]) /\
  (forall (c:comp n) m (s: fin n -> value m) k (t: fin m -> value k),
      (c[s])[t] = c[scomp s t]).
Proof.
  apply (mutind_val_comp
    (fun n (v:value n) => forall m (s: fin n -> value m) k (t: fin m -> value k), (v[s])[t] = v[scomp s t])
    (fun n (c:comp n) => forall m (s: fin n -> value m) k (t: fin m -> value k), (c[s])[t] = c[scomp s t])).
  - intros i m s k t. reflexivity.
  - intros m s k t. reflexivity.
  - intros v1 v2 IH1 IH2 m s k t. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2].
  - intros b v IH m s k t. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros v IH m s k t. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros m s k t. reflexivity.
  - intros v IH m s k t. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros c IH m s k t. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
    intros [i|]; cbn. reflexivity.
    rewrite (proj1 (ren_subst (S n)) (v:=s i) (xi:=shift) (s:=@up_value_value m k t)).
    rewrite (proj1 (subst_ren (S n)) (v:=s i) (s:=t) (xi:=shift)).
    apply (proj1 (subst_ext (S n))). intros j. reflexivity.
  - intros c v IH1 IH2 m s k t. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2].
  - intros c1 c2 IH1 IH2 m s k t. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2].
  - intros v IH m s k t. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros c1 c2 IH1 IH2 m s k t. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2].
  - intros b c IH m s k t. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros v IH m s k t. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros v c1 c2 IH1 IH2 m s k t. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2].
  - intros v c IH m s k t. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
    intros [[i|]|]; cbn. reflexivity.
    rewrite (proj2 (ren_subst (S (S n))) (v:=s i) (xi:=shift) (s:=@up_value_value (S n) k t)).
    rewrite (proj2 (subst_ren (S (S n))) (v:=s i) (s:=t) (xi:=shift)).
    apply (proj2 (subst_ext (S (S n)))). intros j. reflexivity.
    rewrite (proj2 (ren_subst (S (S n))) (v:=s i) (xi:=shift) (s:=@up_value_value (S n) k t)).
    rewrite (proj2 (subst_ren (S (S n))) (v:=s i) (s:=t) (xi:=shift)).
    apply (proj2 (subst_ext (S (S n)))). intros j. reflexivity.
Qed.

Require Import CBPV.SyntacticTyping CBPV.AbstractReductionSystems CBPV.StrongReduction.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Logic List.

Require Import Classes.Morphisms.

Import List Notations.

Import CommaNotation.

(** * Basic substitution / renaming algebra *)

Definition idsv {n} : fin n -> value n := @ids value VarInstance_value n.

Definition renv {n m} (xi : fin n -> fin m) : fin n -> value m :=
  fun i => @var_value m (xi i).

Definition scomp {n m k} (s : fin n -> value m) (t : fin m -> value k) : fin n -> value k :=
  fun i => (s i)[t].

Definition sren {n m k} (s : fin n -> value m) (xi : fin m -> fin k) : fin n -> value k :=
  fun i => (s i)⟨xi⟩.

Definition rscomp {n m k} (xi : fin n -> fin m) (s : fin m -> value k) : fin n -> value k :=
  fun i => s (xi i).

(** Pointwise equality of substitutions is respected. *)
Lemma subst_ext :
  (forall n (v:value n) m (s t : fin n -> value m),
      (forall i, s i = t i) -> v[s] = v[t]) /\
  (forall n (c:comp n) m (s t : fin n -> value m),
      (forall i, s i = t i) -> c[s] = c[t]).
Proof.
  apply (mutind_val_comp
    (fun n (v:value n) => forall m (s t : fin n -> value m), (forall i, s i = t i) -> v[s] = v[t])
    (fun n (c:comp n) => forall m (s t : fin n -> value m), (forall i, s i = t i) -> c[s] = c[t])).
  - intros n i m s t H. cbn. apply H.
  - intros n m s t H. reflexivity.
  - intros n v1 v2 IH1 IH2 m s t H. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2]; auto.
  - intros n b v IH m s t H. cbn. f_equal. apply IH; auto.
  - intros n v IH m s t H. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
    intros [i|]; cbn. reflexivity. rewrite H. reflexivity.
  - intros n m s t H. reflexivity.
  - intros n v IH m s t H. cbn. f_equal. apply IH; auto.
  - intros n c IH m s t H. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
    intros [i|]; cbn. reflexivity. rewrite H. reflexivity.
  - intros n c v IH1 IH2 m s t H. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2]; auto.
  - intros n c1 c2 IH1 IH2 m s t H. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2]; auto.
  - intros n v IH m s t H. cbn. f_equal. apply IH; auto.
  - intros n c1 c2 IH1 IH2 m s t H. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2]; auto.
  - intros n b c IH m s t H. cbn. f_equal. apply IH; auto.
  - intros n v IH m s t H. cbn. f_equal. apply IH; auto.
  - intros n v c1 c2 IH1 IH2 m s t H. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2]; auto.
  - intros n v c IH m s t H. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
    intros [[i|]|]; cbn; auto; rewrite H; reflexivity.
Qed.

(** Pointwise equality of renamings is respected. *)
Lemma ren_ext :
  (forall n (v:value n) m (xi zeta : fin n -> fin m),
      (forall i, xi i = zeta i) -> v⟨xi⟩ = v⟨zeta⟩) /\
  (forall n (c:comp n) m (xi zeta : fin n -> fin m),
      (forall i, xi i = zeta i) -> c⟨xi⟩ = c⟨zeta⟩).
Proof.
  apply (mutind_val_comp
    (fun n (v:value n) => forall m (xi zeta : fin n -> fin m), (forall i, xi i = zeta i) -> v⟨xi⟩ = v⟨zeta⟩)
    (fun n (c:comp n) => forall m (xi zeta : fin n -> fin m), (forall i, xi i = zeta i) -> c⟨xi⟩ = c⟨zeta⟩)).
  - intros n i m xi zeta H. cbn. apply H.
  - intros n m xi zeta H. reflexivity.
  - intros n v1 v2 IH1 IH2 m xi zeta H. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2]; auto.
  - intros n b v IH m xi zeta H. cbn. f_equal. apply IH; auto.
  - intros n v IH m xi zeta H. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
    intros [i|]; cbn. reflexivity. rewrite H. reflexivity.
  - intros n m xi zeta H. reflexivity.
  - intros n v IH m xi zeta H. cbn. f_equal. apply IH; auto.
  - intros n c IH m xi zeta H. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
    intros [i|]; cbn. reflexivity. rewrite H. reflexivity.
  - intros n c v IH1 IH2 m xi zeta H. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2]; auto.
  - intros n c1 c2 IH1 IH2 m xi zeta H. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2]; auto.
  - intros n v IH m xi zeta H. cbn. f_equal. apply IH; auto.
  - intros n c1 c2 IH1 IH2 m xi zeta H. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2]; auto.
  - intros n b c IH m xi zeta H. cbn. f_equal. apply IH; auto.
  - intros n v IH m xi zeta H. cbn. f_equal. apply IH; auto.
  - intros n v c1 c2 IH1 IH2 m xi zeta H. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2]; auto.
  - intros n v c IH m xi zeta H. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
    intros [[i|]|]; cbn; auto; rewrite H; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ren_is_subst :
  (forall n (v:value n) m (xi: fin n -> fin m), v⟨xi⟩ = v[renv xi]) /\
  (forall n (c:comp n) m (xi: fin n -> fin m), c⟨xi⟩ = c[renv xi]).
Proof.
  apply (mutind_val_comp
    (fun n (v:value n) => forall m (xi: fin n -> fin m), v⟨xi⟩ = v[renv xi])
    (fun n (c:comp n) => forall m (xi: fin n -> fin m), c⟨xi⟩ = c[renv xi])).
  - intros n i m xi. reflexivity.
  - intros n m xi. reflexivity.
  - intros n v1 v2 IH1 IH2 m xi. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2].
  - intros n b v IH m xi. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros n v IH m xi. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros n m xi. reflexivity.
  - intros n v IH m xi. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros n c IH m xi. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros n c v IH1 IH2 m xi. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2].
  - intros n c1 c2 IH1 IH2 m xi. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2].
  - intros n v IH m xi. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros n c1 c2 IH1 IH2 m xi. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2].
  - intros n b c IH m xi. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros n v IH m xi. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros n v c1 c2 IH1 IH2 m xi. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2].
  - intros n v c IH m xi. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
Qed.

Lemma ren_subst :
  (forall n (v:value n) m (xi: ren n m) k (s: fin m -> value k),
      (v⟨xi⟩)[s] = v[rscomp xi s]) /\
  (forall n (c:comp n) m (xi: ren n m) k (s: fin m -> value k),
      (c⟨xi⟩)[s] = c[rscomp xi s]).
Proof.
  apply (mutind_val_comp
    (fun n (v:value n) => forall m (xi: ren n m) k (s: fin m -> value k), (v⟨xi⟩)[s] = v[rscomp xi s])
    (fun n (c:comp n) => forall m (xi: ren n m) k (s: fin m -> value k), (c⟨xi⟩)[s] = c[rscomp xi s])).
  - intros n i m xi k s. reflexivity.
  - intros n m xi k s. reflexivity.
  - intros n v1 v2 IH1 IH2 m xi k s. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2].
  - intros n b v IH m xi k s. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros n v IH m xi k s. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros n m xi k s. reflexivity.
  - intros n v IH m xi k s. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros n c IH m xi k s. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
    intros [i|]; cbn. reflexivity. reflexivity.
  - intros n c v IH1 IH2 m xi k s. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2].
  - intros n c1 c2 IH1 IH2 m xi k s. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2].
  - intros n v IH m xi k s. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros n c1 c2 IH1 IH2 m xi k s. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2].
  - intros n b c IH m xi k s. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros n v IH m xi k s. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros n v c1 c2 IH1 IH2 m xi k s. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2].
  - intros n v c IH m xi k s. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
    intros [[i|]|]; cbn; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subst_ren :
  (forall n (v:value n) m (s: fin n -> value m) k (xi: ren m k),
      (v[s])⟨xi⟩ = v[sren s xi]) /\
  (forall n (c:comp n) m (s: fin n -> value m) k (xi: ren m k),
      (c[s])⟨xi⟩ = c[sren s xi]).
Proof.
  apply (mutind_val_comp
    (fun n (v:value n) => forall m (s: fin n -> value m) k (xi: ren m k), (v[s])⟨xi⟩ = v[sren s xi])
    (fun n (c:comp n) => forall m (s: fin n -> value m) k (xi: ren m k), (c[s])⟨xi⟩ = c[sren s xi])).
  - intros n i m s k xi. reflexivity.
  - intros n m s k xi. reflexivity.
  - intros n v1 v2 IH1 IH2 m s k xi. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2].
  - intros n b v IH m s k xi. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros n v IH m s k xi. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros n m s k xi. reflexivity.
  - intros n v IH m s k xi. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros n c IH m s k xi. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
    intros [i|]; cbn. reflexivity.
    apply (proj2 ren_ext); intros j; cbn. reflexivity.
  - intros n c v IH1 IH2 m s k xi. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2].
  - intros n c1 c2 IH1 IH2 m s k xi. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2].
  - intros n v IH m s k xi. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros n c1 c2 IH1 IH2 m s k xi. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2].
  - intros n b c IH m s k xi. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros n v IH m s k xi. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros n v c1 c2 IH1 IH2 m s k xi. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2].
  - intros n v c IH m s k xi. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
    intros [[i|]|]; cbn. reflexivity.
    apply (proj2 ren_ext); intros j; cbn. reflexivity.
    apply (proj2 ren_ext); intros j; cbn. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subst_subst :
  (forall n (v:value n) m (s: fin n -> value m) k (t: fin m -> value k),
      (v[s])[t] = v[scomp s t]) /\
  (forall n (c:comp n) m (s: fin n -> value m) k (t: fin m -> value k),
      (c[s])[t] = c[scomp s t]).
Proof.
  apply (mutind_val_comp
    (fun n (v:value n) => forall m (s: fin n -> value m) k (t: fin m -> value k), (v[s])[t] = v[scomp s t])
    (fun n (c:comp n) => forall m (s: fin n -> value m) k (t: fin m -> value k), (c[s])[t] = c[scomp s t])).
  - intros n i m s k t. reflexivity.
  - intros n m s k t. reflexivity.
  - intros n v1 v2 IH1 IH2 m s k t. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2].
  - intros n b v IH m s k t. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros n v IH m s k t. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros n m s k t. reflexivity.
  - intros n v IH m s k t. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros n c IH m s k t. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
    intros [i|]; cbn. reflexivity.
    (* ((s i) <shift>) [up t] = ((s i)[t]) <shift> *)
    rewrite (proj1 ren_subst (v:=s i) (xi:=shift) (s:=@up_value_value m k t)).
    rewrite (proj1 subst_ren (v:=s i) (s:=t) (xi:=shift)).
    apply (proj1 subst_ext). intros j. reflexivity.
  - intros n c v IH1 IH2 m s k t. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2].
  - intros n c1 c2 IH1 IH2 m s k t. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2].
  - intros n v IH m s k t. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros n c1 c2 IH1 IH2 m s k t. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2].
  - intros n b c IH m s k t. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros n v IH m s k t. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros n v c1 c2 IH1 IH2 m s k t. cbn. f_equal; [apply IH1|apply IH2].
  - intros n v c IH m s k t. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
    intros [[i|]|]; cbn. reflexivity.
    rewrite (proj2 ren_subst (v:=s i) (xi:=shift) (s:=@up_value_value m k t)).
    rewrite (proj2 subst_ren (v:=s i) (s:=t) (xi:=shift)).
    apply (proj2 subst_ext). intros j. reflexivity.
    rewrite (proj2 ren_subst (v:=s i) (xi:=shift) (s:=@up_value_value m k t)).
    rewrite (proj2 subst_ren (v:=s i) (s:=t) (xi:=shift)).
    apply (proj2 subst_ext). intros j. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subst_ids :
  (forall n (v:value n), v[idsv] = v) /\ (forall n (c:comp n), c[idsv] = c).
Proof.
  apply (mutind_val_comp (fun n (v:value n) => v[idsv] = v) (fun n (c:comp n) => c[idsv] = c)).
  - intros n i. reflexivity.
  - intros n. reflexivity.

  - intros n c IH. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros n c v IH1 IH2. cbn. f_equal; auto.
  - intros n c1 c2 IH1 IH2. cbn. f_equal; auto.
  - intros n v IH. cbn. f_equal; auto.
  - intros n c1 c2 IH1 IH2. cbn. f_equal; auto.
  - intros n b c IH. cbn. f_equal; auto.
  - intros n v IH. cbn. f_equal; auto.
  - intros n v c1 c2 IH1 IH2. cbn. f_equal; auto.
  - intros n v c IH. cbn. f_equal.
    apply IH. intros [[i|]|]; cbn; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ren_ids :
  (forall n (v:value n), v⟨idren⟩ = v) /\ (forall n (c:comp n), c⟨idren⟩ = c).
Proof.

Lemma SNc_tuple n (c1 c2:comp n) : SN sstep c1 -> SN sstep c2 -> SN sstep (tuple c1 c2).
Proof.
  intros c1 c2 H1 H2. revert c2 H2. induction H1 as [c10 Hf1 IH1]; intros c2 H2.
  pose proof H2 as H2'. induction H2 as [c2 Hf2 IH2]. apply SNC. intros d Hd. inversion Hd; subst.
  - eapply IH1; [exact H | exact H2'].
  - eapply IH2; [exact H].
  - match goal with Hp : @pstep ?a ?b ?c |- _ => inversion Hp end.
Qed.

Lemma SNc_lambda n (b:comp (S n)) : SN sstep b -> SN sstep (lambda b).
Proof.
  intros H. induction H as [b Hf IH]. apply SNC. intros d Hd. inversion Hd; subst.
  - apply IH. assumption.
  - match goal with Hp : @pstep ?a ?b ?c |- _ => inversion Hp end.
Qed.

```
Theorem strong_normalisation_cbpv n (Gamma: ctx n) P B:
  Gamma ⊢ P : B -> SN sstep P.
Proof.
  intros H.
  (* apply FUND at ambient n with sigma = idsv *)
  assert (GS : GSubst Gamma (@idsv n)).
  { intros i. apply Vv_var. }
  pose proof (proj2 (FUND n Gamma) P B H n (@idsv n) GS) as Hc.
  rewrite (proj2 (subst_ids n) P) in Hc.  (* P[idsv] = P *)
  apply (Vc_SN n B P Hc).
```
Need FUND n Gamma: its statement `forall m Gamma, (...) /\ (...)`, so `FUND n Gamma` has the conjunction. proj2 gives forall c B, Gamma⊢c:B -> forall n sigma, GSubst -> Vc B (c[sigma]). Apply with P B H n idsv GS. Then Hc : Vc B (P[idsv]); rewrite subst_ids n proj2 P: `(proj2 (subst_ids n)) P : P[idsv] = P`. So rewrite in Hc. Then Vc_SN gives SN P (with c:=P, B:=B). `exact (@Vc_SN n B P Hc)` or `apply (Vc_SN ...)`.

Require Import CBPV.SyntacticTyping CBPV.AbstractReductionSystems CBPV.StrongReduction.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Logic List.

Require Import Classes.Morphisms.

Import List Notations.

Theorem strong_normalisation_cbpv n (Gamma: ctx n) P B:
  Gamma ⊢ P : B -> SN sstep P.
===

Theorem strong_normalisation_cbpv n (Gamma: ctx n) P B:
  Gamma ⊢ P : B -> SN sstep P.
Proof.
  intros H.
  assert (GS : GSubst Gamma (@idsv n)).
  { intros i. apply Vv_var. }
  pose proof (proj2 (FUND Gamma) P B H n (@idsv n) GS) as Hc.
  rewrite (proj2 (subst_ids n) P) in Hc.
  exact (@Vc_SN n B P Hc).
Qed.
